bioconda.name: threadfin
bioconda.summary: Relationships between B-cell clones from paired single-cell RNA and BCR sequencing.
bioconda.description:
Threadfin takes paired single-cell RNA and receptor (BCR or TCR) sequencing and describes every clone by the
distribution of its cells' transcriptional states, so that clones, not cells, can be compared, mapped and tested:
clone embeddings, clonal coherence, clonal programmes, clone-level tests and clonal memory.
